contract: item_added carries the created library item's old-format expanded document (id, libraryId, folderId, path, mediaType, media.metadata.title, media.coverPath) and reaches every socket whose user can access the item, including users limited to the podcast library, but no unauthenticated socket; it is emitted after the item exists and after the response body of POST /api/podcasts, not on a rejected creation.
exceptions: Only the POST /api/podcasts call site is asserted; the OPML import (PodcastManager.js:723) and the file-watcher single-item add (LibraryScanner.js:631) call sites are not, because the watcher is timing dependent and OPML import needs an RSS fetch task.
force is not applicable: podcast creation has no force or override mode.
